protocol.cohort: Original previously reused PINNS development split: 5,686 train / 1,100 val / 497 test, 47 clips, four sites. Five 10 Hz observed slots (0.4 s span), anchor observed, at least two valid historical slots and 15/30 future points. All methods share windows; missing history is zero with mask. Validation and test are scores only.
protocol.source: Same-clip training-only reference starts at that clip's earliest training trigger and covers at most six seconds. Every source time precedes the target anchor and the earliest held window's 19-frame history. At least seven distinct training timestamps are required. Median of seven BEV frames provides generic Canny image contours. The convex hull uses only other annotated pedestrians in the reference; the target's whole ID is excluded. No available reference or local geometry is not evidence of empty/open physical space. Neither input is a verified curb or walkable boundary.
protocol.models: OLS velocity from available historical points at actual timestamps, extrapolated from t0. The four independent direct residual ridge fits use: (1) four historical xy offsets, four masks and two OLS velocity components; (2) same motion plus three flags: historical reference exists, locally usable image segments, locally usable hull segments; (3) same flags and image-only continuous geometry; (4) same flags and hull-only continuous geometry. Subsequent comparisons with availability thus condition on the same information about availability in both branches. Select nearest point on any segment between consecutive valid sampled polyline vertices; deterministic line/segment order breaks ties. Encode relative xy, distance, axial orientation (cos 2theta, sin 2theta, unchanged if reversed), and ego velocity toward that point (0 at coincident points). Missing geometry receives six zeros plus the availability flags.
protocol.training: Each of 30 leads is fitted separately on that lead's ground-truth-available training rows with equal weights. Recompute column mean/population SD on these rows (SD<=1e-10 uses 1). Predict residual xy to OLS, unpenalized intercept, fixed mean squared loss + 0.1 times coefficient squared norm. No tuning or cross-split normalization.
protocol.score: Window ADE averages Euclidean error over available future points, then averages windows. Original FDE uses the last valid target, regardless of lead; additionally report exact 3.0 s FDE only for rows with the 30th target. Validation and test are scored separately; common-map support is a secondary descriptive subgroup.
protocol.primary: Test pooled window-weighted ADE difference (image geometry minus availability only), lower is better. Within each of the four fixed locations sample its whole evaluation clips with replacement, retaining all their windows; keep each site's original test-window weight when averaging the four bootstrap site means. 20,000 draws, seed 2026, percentile 95% interval conditional on fitted models. Related recordings and shared training may induce dependence. Hull comparisons, last-valid/exact FDE, per-site and common-support scores are secondary. These four reused sites give development evidence.

independent_verification.source: Reconstructed candidate windows, masks, split and ground truth from typed official positions; rebuilt image/hull descriptors on the exact frozen tensors, then replayed saved parameters with no refit. Validation/test, each site and common-map subgroup, all three error definitions, and the preregistered paired clip interval were checked.
